interpretationWarnings: Product focus metadata is presentation and research-priority classification only; it asserts no evidence, authorization, compatibility, dependency, producer selection, adapter, execution order, architecture, or build order.

warnings: Matching artifact type IDs indicate candidate semantic compatibility only; they do not assert a tested binding, dependency, architecture, runtime pipeline, or build order.
An orphan row is a topology observation, not automatically a gap: optional absence, unused alternatives, classified external roots, and intentional handoffs remain visible.

artifactTypes.description: A finite, ordered set of observations in the paper's standard normed feature setting.
artifactTypes.label: Finite archetypoids observation set
provenanceNotes: Observation identity, feature definition, scaling, order, and multiplicity policy must be retained; no population weighting is implied.
sourceNotes: Finite observations in a normed feature setting are the archetypoids data input.

artifactTypes.description: The selected observed exemplars after BUILD/SWAP local optimization.
artifactTypes.label: Locally optimized archetypoids
provenanceNotes: Selection as an exemplar does not establish role, support, semantic belonging, or population representativeness.
sourceNotes: Outputs are observed data points rather than synthetic archetypes.

artifactTypes.description: A complete source-supported treatment domain for which no legal two-color treatment remains under the declared search boundary.
artifactTypes.label: Complete infeasible source domain
provenanceNotes: Completeness and infeasibility are scoped claims; they cannot establish the semantic phrase genuinely no other way.
sourceNotes: Represents the complete infeasible source domain input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:205-206.

artifactTypes.description: A declared domain of complete-treatment descriptors and their internal treatments, cardinality, scores, and rejection accounting. State is explicitly nonempty, empty, or infeasible; empty membership is not confused with a missing artifact.
artifactTypes.label: Complete-treatment tuple domain
provenanceNotes: The domain records its construction and policy identities; it is not interchangeable with one descriptor or one selected treatment.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1337-1341, :1475-1478, and :1541-1544 require declared-domain scope and explicit infeasibility.

notes: Only the declared state discriminator is exposed for graph-level constraint inspection.
This inspection-only discriminator makes empty, infeasible, and populated domain states machine-checkable without defining the complete runtime payload schema.

artifactTypes.description: Finite background, surface, foreground, accent, and field-state alternatives with declared factor membership. This is a factor domain, not a domain of already constructed complete tuples.
artifactTypes.label: Finite treatment tuple factors
provenanceNotes: Factor identity and finite cardinality must be retained; an empty factor is explicit rather than omitted.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1334-1341 and :1352-1358 distinguish finite tuple factors from feasible complete treatments.

artifactTypes.description: Development-only unselected flat, linear, and radial hypotheses, each retaining p95 residual, geometry, stop count, explanation cost, and where applicable an exact-source path of two to four observed stops plus all tied and losing alternatives.
artifactTypes.label: Gradient MDL structure alternatives
provenanceNotes: Outputs derived from known-good masks remain development values; this artifact never represents a selected publishable path.
sourceNotes: Required alternatives and exact 2-4 source-supported stops are specified in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1286-1292.

artifactTypes.description: Occupied native-image color bins above a declared population floor, each represented by an exact source pixel with count, fraction, family, coordinates, and quantization identity.
artifactTypes.label: Populated exact artwork colors
provenanceNotes: Population floor, quantization step, native raster identity, and exact representative pixel are part of the value.
sourceNotes: The 0.001-supported color-set construction is in research/v2-3/src/internal/ramp-midpoint.ts:44-55,88-171.

artifactTypes.description: A packed source-pixel buffer containing adaptive morphology/Sobel contour pixels without a full-size lattice.
artifactTypes.label: Packed adaptive contour pixels
provenanceNotes: Retains contour order, source offsets, channel count, documented double channel multiplication in allocation, and originating raster identity.
sourceNotes: Distinct from fixed-threshold rectangle pixels and from component-level typography hypotheses.

artifactTypes.description: A packed source-pixel buffer containing pixels from grouped fixed-threshold rectangles without a full-size lattice.
artifactTypes.label: Packed fixed-threshold rectangle pixels
provenanceNotes: Retains source offsets, rectangle order, channel count, allocated length behavior, and originating full-size raster identity.
sourceNotes: Semantically and structurally distinct from the full-size rectangle buffer and adaptive contour outputs.

artifactTypes.description: The returned map from observed representative packed RGB colors to full weighted cluster populations.
artifactTypes.label: Public legacy k-means observed-color map
provenanceNotes: Duplicate observed representative keys can overwrite earlier clusters; values do not include native pixel witnesses.
sourceNotes: This is the public k-means/election output; it does not expose cluster memberships, synthesized means, selected K, WCSS points, or slopes.

artifactTypes.description: A finite set of stable alternative IDs to be compared, without embedded criterion performance, ordering, or selected-winner state.
artifactTypes.label: Multicriteria alternative set
provenanceNotes: Alternatives can reference treatments only through a separately typed candidate contract; this set is not itself a treatment.
sourceNotes: Alternatives input at MECHANISMS.md:2289-2292.

artifactTypes.description: Candidates that survive every applicable noncompensatory block comparison, including an explicit empty subset when all candidates fail or the input is empty.
artifactTypes.label: Noncompensatory survivor subset
provenanceNotes: Survival is relative to the supplied blocks and does not imply a total order or winner.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1458-1459 requires survivors separately from pairwise verdicts.

artifactTypes.description: Up to M stable hypothesis IDs ordered by the declared generation/objective policy while retaining structurally diverse near-optimal alternatives.
artifactTypes.label: Ordered diverse hypothesis set
provenanceNotes: Ordering is not final selection, and membership is not a complete-treatment authorization.
sourceNotes: Ordered hypothesis-set output at MECHANISMS.md:2247-2248.

artifactTypes.description: Exactly one native pixel witness per requested role or hypothesis, collected with rank and field provenance.
artifactTypes.label: Rank-published native role pixels
provenanceNotes: Each requested identity retains exact RGB, native index and coordinates, rank, scalar field, ties, and source hash.
sourceNotes: Exact-pixel publication is supported mechanically while role-field semantics remain inconclusive.

artifactTypes.description: Already evaluated source-eligible internal treatments with canonical key and rank, explicitly allowing an empty slate.
artifactTypes.label: Ranked source-eligible repair slate
provenanceNotes: Repair may choose only from the supplied evaluated slate.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1577-1582 and zero-contrast-repair.ts:155-160 require a ranked source-eligible slate.

artifactTypes.description: A compact set of source-space geometric palette vertices selected from the simplified RGBXY hull.
artifactTypes.label: RGBXY palette vertices
provenanceNotes: Vertices are decomposition coordinates, not UI role assignments or a complete treatment; observed/synthetic status must be explicit.
sourceNotes: Palette vertices are distinct from per-pixel mixing layers.

artifactTypes.description: The subset having at least one descriptor with complete ordinary source lineage or the exact declared emergency basis. The subset may explicitly be empty.
artifactTypes.label: Source-eligible treatment subset
provenanceNotes: Eligibility proves custody consistency, not semantic belonging or quality.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1473-1478 and source-eligibility.ts:218-261 define descriptor-based subset filtering.

artifactTypes.description: A finite, stably identified set of structured hypotheses with no ordering, election, or product authority.
artifactTypes.label: Finite structured hypothesis set
provenanceNotes: Members may be masks, fields, or treatment candidates only when their own contracts say so; this set is not the exact UI treatment contract.
sourceNotes: Finite hypothesis domains are required by MECHANISMS.md:2245-2248 and 2272-2275.

artifactTypes.description: The stable item subset selected by fixed-cardinality greedy marginal-gain maximization, bounded by the declared budget.
artifactTypes.label: Budget-bounded selected subset
provenanceNotes: This is a fixed-budget subset, not a target-cover subset, partial preorder, or complete UI treatment.
sourceNotes: Bounded selected-subset output at MECHANISMS.md:2274-2275.

artifactTypes.description: A finite set of stable item IDs eligible for a declared submodular selection problem, without costs, values, or selection state hidden in the contract.
artifactTypes.label: Submodular selection item universe
provenanceNotes: Items are candidates, not selected treatments or the exact product contract.
sourceNotes: Makes the item/hypothesis universe implicit in MECHANISMS.md:2261-2262 and explicit in 2274-2275 a typed input.

artifactTypes.description: The stable item subset selected by greedy minimum-cost target cover, with total selection cost and target-reach termination state.
artifactTypes.label: Target-cover selected subset
provenanceNotes: This is a target-cover subset, not a fixed-budget subset, a partial preorder, or a selected UI treatment.
sourceNotes: Selected-subset output at MECHANISMS.md:2261-2262.

artifactTypes.description: The nondominated subset of a named complete-treatment domain under a named partial order. It may be explicitly empty only when the input domain is empty.
artifactTypes.label: Treatment Pareto subset
provenanceNotes: A frontier is a subset, not a total ranking or selected winner.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1368-1375 defines retention without winner selection; NATIVE_COMPLETE_PALETTE_PROTOCOL.md:325-333 uses a separate post-admission Pareto subset.

artifactTypes.description: Candidate lanes read from hierarchy nodes at declared containment scales, including exact-pixel representatives.
artifactTypes.label: Tree-of-shapes candidate lanes
provenanceNotes: Retains hierarchy node, lane policy, containment scale, attributes, exact representative, and candidate ordering.
sourceNotes: Reachability remains separate from assignment-set stability, ranking, and role correctness.

artifactTypes.description: The estimated center in the declared structured-output metric space, present only when the certification procedure does not abstain.
artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothed structured output
provenanceNotes: This generic structured center is not a runtime treatment artifact or the exact UI treatment contract.
sourceNotes: Center-output result at MECHANISMS.md:2340-2341.

artifactTypes.description: One dense-exact, nearest-prototype, band-local endpoint, or historical density-synthesized family representative with support and tie provenance.
artifactTypes.label: Family representative alternative
provenanceNotes: Exact witnesses are required where applicable; density-synthesized values remain marked as non-ordinary publication.
sourceNotes: The finite alternatives expose support and fidelity tradeoffs rather than declaring one universal representative.

artifactTypes.description: One source-connected candidate color proposed for foreground evaluation without elected-role authority.
artifactTypes.label: Foreground color candidate
provenanceNotes: Candidate identity and exact-source or generated state remain explicit.
sourceNotes: Foreground candidates may be supplied by multiple evidence mechanisms.

artifactTypes.description: One exact observed source color from a supported chromatic family absent from the canonical shortlist.
artifactTypes.label: Exact-source hue-family supplement
provenanceNotes: Supplement availability grants neither role authorization nor final selection.
sourceNotes: A run emits zero, one, or two supplements; the output is not an augmented shortlist.

artifactTypes.description: One shortlisted color with cluster and evidence provenance and an exact observed source representative.
artifactTypes.label: Role-aware exact-color shortlist candidate
provenanceNotes: Candidacy does not grant role reachability, role assignment, or final selection.
sourceNotes: The historical shortlist is about 12 records but may contain only one record for a uniform source.

artifactTypes.description: One exact-source color nominated by structural text or ink evidence with support, geometry, repetition, and uncertainty.
artifactTypes.label: Text-like exact-source candidate
provenanceNotes: Every candidate retains exact source support and structural evidence rather than an OCR truth label.
sourceNotes: Text-like candidates may include decoration, labels, or missed typography and therefore remain hypotheses.

artifactTypes.description: One logical descriptor binding an internal complete treatment to field hypothesis, source mode, complete lineage, canonical key, and evaluation evidence. Distinct descriptors may describe the same internal treatment.
artifactTypes.label: Complete-treatment descriptor
provenanceNotes: Descriptor multiplicity and lineage survive treatment-key equality.
sourceNotes: research/v2-3/src/internal/candidate-domain.ts:23-28 and candidate-materialization.ts:11-15 retain logical descriptors separately from canonical treatments.

artifactTypes.description: Zero or one exact-source stop nomination at position 0.5, discriminated by spatial-midpoint-band or transition-path-stage origin and retaining that route's population, position, family, region, chord, and witness evidence.
artifactTypes.label: Source-supported gradient midpoint nomination
provenanceNotes: A nomination has no independent authority to become a rendered stop; null is a valid route result.
sourceNotes: The two distinct provenance variants are defined in research/v2-3/src/internal/gradient-support.ts:19-75.

artifactTypes.description: One assigned observed packed RGB color nearest to a synthesized cluster mean, paired with the cluster's weighted population.
artifactTypes.label: Observed legacy cluster representative
provenanceNotes: Retains mean-state identity, assigned observation order, nearest-distance tie behavior, and full weighted population.
sourceNotes: Represents the publication step per mean cluster; it is not a native exact-pixel publication witness.

artifactTypes.description: A finite swatch set whose colors are witnessed in the source under explicit observation provenance, without UI roles, contrast claims, or complete-treatment state.
artifactTypes.label: Candidate observed-color theme
provenanceNotes: Observed colors do not establish role assignment, gradient state, contrast, or complete UI quality.
sourceNotes: Candidate observed-color theme input at MECHANISMS.md:2306-2309.

artifactTypes.description: One nominated, null, or ambiguous role-candidate state with coherent salience, exact support, semantic limits, and retained mass evidence.
artifactTypes.label: Salience-led role nomination
provenanceNotes: Null and ambiguous outcomes remain first-class rather than silently dropping a mark.
sourceNotes: The mechanism is unbuilt and nomination does not authorize role assignment or selection.

artifactTypes.description: One candidate per complete treatment key with a stable key, ordered nonduplicate descriptors, and unioned strata.
artifactTypes.label: Canonical candidate treatment with retained descriptors
provenanceNotes: Deduplication retains all consequential evidence and uncertainty and does not make the candidate a final palette.
sourceNotes: Only byte-equivalent complete candidate treatments may share a canonical record.

artifactTypes.description: One retained canonical candidate in the ordered capacity-bounded subset with descriptor and stratum-coverage provenance.
artifactTypes.label: Capacity-materialized candidate treatment
provenanceNotes: Admission under a cap is displacement-sensitive: additions can evict prior candidates without changing their intrinsic evidence.
sourceNotes: A run retains at least one and at most the configured capacity, never above 1500.

artifactTypes.description: Background, surface, foreground, accent, and gradient boolean returned by the live role-by-role heuristic election.
artifactTypes.label: Legacy independently elected role candidate
provenanceNotes: This legacy result is not the exact UI treatment contract and must not be presented as a final contract palette.
sourceNotes: Independently elected roles need not form a faithful complete treatment.

artifactTypes.description: A three-component arithmetic mean over the declared CIELAB raster domain, with source raster, conversion, inclusion mask, accumulation order, and precision identity.
artifactTypes.label: Global mean CIELAB color
provenanceNotes: Must derive from the same raster and conversion used by the saliency execution; split-field inadequacy remains visible.
sourceNotes: Global-mean input at MECHANISMS.md:2466-2471.

artifactTypes.description: One exact native source-pixel endpoint color with pixel index, coordinates, endpoint side, band and target identities, and support evidence.
artifactTypes.label: Exact gradient endpoint witness
provenanceNotes: RGB and hex must be derived from the named native pixel; nearest-target synthesis is forbidden.
sourceNotes: The endpoint-snap output is one exact witness in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1128-1131.

artifactTypes.description: A directed background-to-surface pair of exact native source-pixel colors, retaining endpoint order, native witnesses, and source support.
artifactTypes.label: Ordered exact gradient endpoint pair
provenanceNotes: Both colors must carry native pixel witnesses; reversing the pair produces a distinct value.
sourceNotes: Direction is material for owned-continuity evidence in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1055-1064.

artifactTypes.description: One floating-point OKLab color value with declared conversion and source or hypothesis provenance; it is not an ordered pixel plane.
artifactTypes.label: Individual OKLab color triple
provenanceNotes: A standalone color must retain its own source or hypothesis identity and cannot imply native pixel-plane cardinality.
sourceNotes: Individual color comparisons require explicit values; the ordered per-pixel conversion is represented by raster-plane artifact types instead.

artifactTypes.description: One named UI role color represented by an exact native source pixel and canonical opaque sRGB8 value.
artifactTypes.label: Exact-source role color
provenanceNotes: Role name and exact source witness must accompany the color so foreground and accent obligations are not conflated.
sourceNotes: Whole-ramp contrast evaluates a role color in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1251-1255.

artifactTypes.description: Bound functions, validity assumptions, and objective identity used to prune branches without excluding the optimum for that objective.
artifactTypes.label: Admissible search bounds
provenanceNotes: A certificate must bind both objective and bound identities.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1352-1357 makes admissible bound validity load-bearing.

artifactTypes.description: Dedicated consumer, experiment, supplied-answer semantics, minimum-content, comparison, labeling, and prohibited-claim declaration.
artifactTypes.label: Answer-bearing upper-bound declaration
provenanceNotes: The declaration bars fitting, natural-handoff, generalization, runtime, quality, and advancement reuse.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.17 requires dedicated identities and an exact declaration of supplied semantics.

artifactTypes.description: The exact BUILD initialization choice, tie policy, and deterministic observation ordering used before SWAP.
artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids BUILD initialization
provenanceNotes: Initial witness indices, tie rule, order, and implementation revision must be retained.
sourceNotes: BUILD initialization is explicit because BUILD/SWAP reaches a local optimum.

artifactTypes.description: The requested number of observed archetypal representatives.
artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids cardinality
provenanceNotes: Requested count and any feasibility handling must be explicit.
sourceNotes: Cardinality is an explicit and answer-defining archetypoids input.

artifactTypes.description: An ordered set of component-area thresholds with resolution normalization, connectivity, and null behavior.
artifactTypes.label: Area-granulometry scales
provenanceNotes: Binds ordered thresholds, units, normalization, connectivity, polarity, and empty-domain behavior.
sourceNotes: Area scale defines removed detail and can erase fine typography; no normalized policy is selected.

artifactTypes.description: Declared octave windows, area-integral formula, top-quarter extent rule, field formation, ordering, and comparison policy.
artifactTypes.label: Area-integral extent policy
provenanceNotes: Must bind octave windows, integral boundaries, eligibility, top-quarter rule, field set, ordering, and drift formulas.
sourceNotes: The exact excluded-worktree policy is nonportable archaeology and is not inherited as a validated contract.

artifactTypes.description: Evidence resolutions, quality block order, relational stages, quantization rules, and deterministic fallbacks for a banded treatment comparator.
artifactTypes.label: Banded comparator policy
provenanceNotes: All deciding stages and quanta are configuration, not hidden comparator constants.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1388-1393 and v2-3 winner-scoring.ts:1028-1087 expose the staged comparator policy.

artifactTypes.description: The declared emergency policy restricting generation to exactly one absent pure black or white role and requiring its partner to collapse.
artifactTypes.label: Black-or-white escape configuration
provenanceNotes: The policy identity is required to distinguish this narrow escape from eager generated-color fallback.
sourceNotes: Makes the exact emergency form in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:197-211 a first-class policy input.

artifactTypes.description: The background-prior, graph propagation, saliency optimization, numerical, and stopping constants.
artifactTypes.label: Boundary-connectivity optimization constants
provenanceNotes: Every scale, regularizer, transform, solver tolerance, stopping rule, and revision must be pinned.
sourceNotes: Optimization constants are explicit boundary-connectivity inputs.

artifactTypes.description: The threshold chosen from one declared family, bound to risk level, frozen calibration sample, loss, finite-sample method, and calibration custody identity.
artifactTypes.label: Calibrated monotone-risk threshold
provenanceNotes: Not a cold-inference input unless calibration custody is separately frozen and admitted; the census currently marks runtime prohibited.
sourceNotes: Calibrated-threshold output at MECHANISMS.md:2325-2326.

artifactTypes.description: The declared display, contrast, viewing, spatial-scale, bit-depth, and multiscale-analysis assumptions.
artifactTypes.label: CAMBI display and scale assumptions
provenanceNotes: Scale pyramid, contrast thresholds, display transfer, bit depth, and implementation revision must be pinned.
sourceNotes: Display/scale assumptions are explicit CAMBI inputs.

artifactTypes.description: Repository-local candidate entry point and resolution policy for dependency-closure measurement.
artifactTypes.label: Candidate entry-point declaration
provenanceNotes: The resolution policy and repository boundary are versioned.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.9 requires a candidate entry point.

artifactTypes.description: A nonnegative integer maximum selected-set cardinality, with explicit behavior when it exceeds the eligible universe size.
artifactTypes.label: Cardinality budget
provenanceNotes: Capacity is explicit policy and does not remove displacement.
sourceNotes: Fixed cardinality-budget input at MECHANISMS.md:2272-2275.

artifactTypes.description: Declared confidence level, finite-sample correction, allocation of error probabilities, and abstention boundary comparisons.
artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing confidence configuration
provenanceNotes: Confidence and abstention rules are explicit protocol settings.
sourceNotes: Confidence input at MECHANISMS.md:2340-2341.

artifactTypes.description: A fully specified perturbation distribution and bounded input threat set, including units, norm, radius parameterization, clipping, sampling algorithm, and seed derivation.
artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing perturbation distribution
provenanceNotes: Randomness and byte determinism are separate claims; distribution and seed policy are load-bearing.
sourceNotes: Perturbation-distribution input at MECHANISMS.md:2338-2343.

artifactTypes.description: Pinned sample count, batch policy, pseudorandom generator, seed, center-estimation algorithm, tie handling, resource ceilings, and failure policy.
artifactTypes.label: Center-smoothing sampling configuration
provenanceNotes: Resource conditions and deterministic replay requirements remain research-only and unresolved.
sourceNotes: Sample-count input and repeated-randomized-inference constraint at MECHANISMS.md:2340-2343.

artifactTypes.description: A complete sRGB transfer, XYZ matrix, reference white, adaptation, Lab formula, alpha policy, precision, and clipping configuration.
artifactTypes.label: Pinned CIELAB conversion
provenanceNotes: Conversion revision and numeric precision are behavior-affecting inputs.
sourceNotes: Color-conversion input at MECHANISMS.md:2466-2470.

artifactTypes.description: A named color representation with distance, conversion, and identity-tolerance behavior used by legacy color measurements.
artifactTypes.label: Color-space distance configuration
provenanceNotes: Distance identity and version must be retained because assignment may use a different space from packed-RGB centroid updates.
sourceNotes: Legacy k-means assignment, nearest-observation publication, and local-contrast saliency depend on a supplied color-space implementation.

artifactTypes.description: Explicit settings for role legality, collapse, field states, gradient endpoints, contrast, and rejection-check order used while constructing internal complete treatments.
artifactTypes.label: Complete-treatment legality configuration
provenanceNotes: The configuration identity must travel with constructed domains and reports.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1334-1338 names the jointly evaluated legality settings.

artifactTypes.description: A declared expected-risk bound and finite-sample confidence/error parameters in the units of one bounded monotone loss.
artifactTypes.label: Conformal risk level
provenanceNotes: The risk level is protocol policy and does not turn multi-valid reviewer preference into a monotone loss.
sourceNotes: Risk-level input at MECHANISMS.md:2323-2326.

artifactTypes.description: The local dissimilarity and global range constraints used to form a constrained-connectivity hierarchy.
artifactTypes.label: Constrained-connectivity limits
provenanceNotes: Units, inclusivity, scale policy, and revision must be explicit.
sourceNotes: Both local and global constraints are load-bearing Section 10 inputs.

artifactTypes.description: Quantized quality-block order and resolution followed by ASCII complete-treatment content key, treatment ID, and structural key stages.
artifactTypes.label: Content tie-break policy
provenanceNotes: Role hexes, gradient state, IDs, and structural labels used by the fallback are declared inputs to the policy.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1555-1563 and candidate-materialization.ts:50-71 define the content-first deterministic stages.

artifactTypes.description: The contour extraction, unclip, filtering, coordinate projection, simplification, and tie settings.
artifactTypes.label: DBNet polygon postprocessing settings
provenanceNotes: Every threshold, geometry convention, clipping rule, ordering, and implementation revision must be pinned.
sourceNotes: Polygon postprocessing is a separate effective DBNet input.

artifactTypes.description: The differentiable-binarization steepness, score thresholds, and related threshold-map settings.
artifactTypes.label: DBNet binarization thresholds
provenanceNotes: Values, formulas, inclusivity, scale dependence, calibration, and revision must be pinned.
sourceNotes: Threshold settings are effective DBNet inputs.

artifactTypes.description: Exact semantic value, uncertainty, abstention, coordinate, unit, source-witness, null, and out-of-domain fields accepted by one diagnostic consumer.
artifactTypes.label: Declared consumer input contract
provenanceNotes: The contract excludes review identity, verdict, chronology, sibling cardinality, and downstream-answer fields.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.14 and STRATEGY.md 6.1 require a declared consumer input contract.

artifactTypes.description: The initialization, alternating-update, numerical, tie, convergence, and stopping policy for DECOLOR.
artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR optimization policy
provenanceNotes: Initialization, solver revision, precision, tolerances, iteration limit, and stopping rule must be retained.
sourceNotes: Optimization policy is an explicit DECOLOR input.

artifactTypes.description: The low-rank dimensionality policy and sparsity/contiguity regularization parameters.
artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR rank and regularization choices
provenanceNotes: Values, schedules, units, hard/soft conventions, and revision must be pinned.
sourceNotes: Rank and regularization choices are load-bearing DECOLOR inputs.

artifactTypes.description: The pinned relative-depth convention, confidence handling, uniformity and edge measures, thresholds, and out-of-domain test protocol.
artifactTypes.label: Depth evidence diagnostic policy
provenanceNotes: Thresholds are unmeasured research inputs and cannot convert depth into field truth.
sourceNotes: Section 9 proposes uniformity, edge, confidence, and explicit out-of-domain diagnostics.

artifactTypes.description: The exact decode, resize, crop or center behavior, normalization, coordinate remapping, and output-resampling policy for a depth arm.
artifactTypes.label: Monocular depth preprocessing policy
provenanceNotes: This policy is development-only and cannot silently alter native-source evidence.
sourceNotes: The unbuilt depth route must expose model preprocessing as an effective input.

artifactTypes.description: Explicit total traversal order for branches and tuple factors in an exact search.
artifactTypes.label: Deterministic branch order
provenanceNotes: Order identity supports replay but does not itself rank treatment quality.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1354-1355 requires deterministic branch order.

artifactTypes.description: A total, revisioned rule over stable item IDs for resolving exactly equal or precision-equivalent greedy marginal choices.
artifactTypes.label: Deterministic selection tie rule

sourceNotes: Output states and retained alternatives are specified in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1114-1119.

artifactTypes.description: Linear, radial, or conic geometry actually computed by a field fit, with normalized coordinates, fit identity, domain, parameterization, and uncertainty.
artifactTypes.label: Fitted gradient geometry
provenanceNotes: Geometry is present only when a fit computed it; it must not be synthesized solely for output.
sourceNotes: Optional fitted geometry shape is described in research/v3/src/contract/types.ts:92-113.

artifactTypes.description: An eligible or rejected result for one supplied ordered pair, with detector identity and explicit rejection reasons; it is not a semantic gradient-field verdict.
artifactTypes.label: Gradient pair eligibility claim
provenanceNotes: The claim remains scoped to one pair, one observation source, and one threshold identity.
sourceNotes: The detector emits an eligible/rejected claim in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1040-1043.

artifactTypes.description: A field-level claim with exactly one of flat, gradient, ambiguous, no-field, or out-of-domain, plus supporting geometry and an explicit abstention state.
artifactTypes.label: Semantic gradient-field claim
provenanceNotes: Gradient means continuous shading of one field; endpoint difference alone cannot populate the gradient state.
sourceNotes: Claim states and separation from endpoint refinement come from research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1022-1028.

artifactTypes.description: One or more externally supplied image-coordinate hypotheses for the compositional ground, with no producer typed in this fragment.
artifactTypes.label: Unresolved ground-point hypotheses
provenanceNotes: No mechanism here produces these hypotheses; their pointing-model origin remains an explicit unresolved root and is prohibited at runtime.
sourceNotes: Section 9 names point hypotheses as inputs to the tested point-to-SAM route.

artifactTypes.description: One member of a finite source-supported direction set selected under a declared positive-semidefinite kernel and cardinality bound.
artifactTypes.label: Diverse supported hue direction
provenanceNotes: Family support, quality, hue vector, kernel, and selection step remain attached.
sourceNotes: A direction candidate is not an accent, role, or final palette selection.

artifactTypes.description: One source-connected, materially distinct, non-field-owned family obligation with priority, direction, and evidence provenance.
artifactTypes.label: Ordered identity obligation
provenanceNotes: An obligation is a retention hypothesis, not human semantic truth or final role authority.
sourceNotes: The base list has four seats and post-cap major-family and chromatic reservations can increase the output to six.

artifactTypes.description: A mechanism output in its native semantic form with alternatives, uncertainty, abstention, and exact source witnesses.
artifactTypes.label: Immutable mechanism-native output
provenanceNotes: Mechanism, artifact schema, source bytes, and native witness identities are frozen before review.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.12 requires immutable source and mechanism artifacts.

artifactTypes.description: Content-hashed consumer-facing semantic value with only required uncertainty, abstention, coordinates, units, and source witnesses.
artifactTypes.label: Known-good minimal projection
provenanceNotes: It excludes the reviewed artifact, all custody fields, identifiers, verdicts, corrections, chronology, sibling metadata, and answer equivalents.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.14 defines the leak-audited minimal known-good projection as a declared consumer-facing handoff.

artifactTypes.description: Several independently scored foreground color hypotheses with method identities, scores, and fallback states.
artifactTypes.label: Legacy root foreground-color hypotheses
provenanceNotes: Retains method name, source cluster map, saliency threshold, field color, contrast floor, score, and fallback reason.
sourceNotes: Produced for comparison by the live root caller; this is not a text mask, OCR result, reviewed joint model, or elected complete treatment.

artifactTypes.description: One candidate complete-treatment description with field hypothesis, source mode, source type, strata, and source-connected lineage.
artifactTypes.label: Logical complete-treatment descriptor
provenanceNotes: Descriptor identity includes treatment, field hypothesis, source type, and lineage rather than an ASCII alias.
sourceNotes: Logical descriptors can describe byte-equivalent treatments through different evidence paths.

artifactTypes.description: One mark's cue score normalized by mark mass, its deterministic rank, retained original mass, and eligibility state.
artifactTypes.label: Per-mass mark score and rank
provenanceNotes: Separate semantic and spatial eligibility is required so tiny noise is not amplified into authority.
sourceNotes: Per-mass normalization prevents small coherent marks from being erased by canvas area.

artifactTypes.description: Naturally generated upstream semantic value, including uncertainty, abstention, invalidity, or out-of-domain state, sealed without any protected review field.
artifactTypes.label: Sealed natural producer output
provenanceNotes: This natural output has no producer in this fragment and contains no reviewed target, custody mapping, or answer-equivalent encoding.
sourceNotes: STRATEGY.md 6.2 requires natural and known-good conditions to remain distinct.

artifactTypes.description: Minimum declared answer-equivalent semantic value for one separately identified upper-bound consumer, excluding every raw review and custody field.
artifactTypes.label: Privileged answer-bearing projection
provenanceNotes: This privileged external root is not a known-good projection and cannot be derived by relabeling a failed standard projection.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.17 and STRATEGY.md 6.1 define the distinct answer-bearing-upper-bound class.

artifactTypes.description: Zero or more groups of robust-fit rejections with span, mass, neighborhood, exact-color support, and residual provenance.
artifactTypes.label: Residual mark-group hypotheses
provenanceNotes: Retains fitted model, residual and weight fields, grouping policy, native exact-color support, and empty result.
sourceNotes: Groups are figure-enriched hypotheses, not pure figures or UI role assignments.

artifactTypes.description: One family-by-field matrix cell with foreground and accent scores, preference, reason, confidence, coherent support, field ownership, and polarity evidence.
artifactTypes.label: Field-conditioned family role evidence
provenanceNotes: Ambiguous and field-owned states remain explicit; a matrix cell does not elect a role.
sourceNotes: A complete classifier run emits exactly one record for every family crossed with every field hypothesis.

artifactTypes.description: An explicit development state recording that no candidate mask survived or was emitted for the supplied prompt set.
artifactTypes.label: SAM explicit no-mask state
provenanceNotes: No-mask is an instrument result, not evidence that the prompted concept is absent from the image.
sourceNotes: Section 9 forbids silently replacing an absent SAM mask with a forced candidate.

artifactTypes.description: A color hypothesis with registered observed-source support and lineage sufficient to seek an exact native witness.
artifactTypes.label: Source-supported color hypothesis
provenanceNotes: Source support alone does not assert belonging, representativeness, or role correctness.
sourceNotes: Represents the source-supported color hypothesis input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:173-174.

artifactTypes.description: Optional uncertain chains of components that may form typography-like marks without OCR or text authority.
artifactTypes.label: Optional structural text-chain hypotheses
provenanceNotes: Retains member components, ordering, grouping policy, uncertainty, and explicit absence when no chain is formed.
sourceNotes: Semantically different from the two legacy text-region pixel buffers and from scored root foreground-color hypotheses.

artifactTypes.description: One closed-vocabulary model answer per frozen structural question, with the model note retained as a development hypothesis.
artifactTypes.label: VLM closed-question answer records
provenanceNotes: Answers are not truth, reviewed labels, field ownership, role ownership, or runtime features.
sourceNotes: Section 9 limits these records to development stratification.

artifactTypes.description: A hierarchy of nested unlabeled partitions produced under local and global connectivity constraints.
artifactTypes.label: Constrained-connectivity nested partitions
provenanceNotes: Partition labels are structural identifiers and carry no field, figure, identity, or role semantics.
sourceNotes: One permitted representation of the constrained-connectivity hierarchy.

artifactTypes.description: A node-to-component partition resulting from size-adaptive nondecreasing-edge graph merging.
artifactTypes.label: FH graph partition
provenanceNotes: Retains input graph nodes, final component IDs, deterministic ordering, merge policy, and minimum-size cleanup effects.
sourceNotes: Partition output has no field or figure labels.

artifactTypes.description: One or more unlabeled graph decompositions satisfying the declared local and lifted consistency conditions.
artifactTypes.label: Lifted-multicut graph decompositions
provenanceNotes: Component labels encode no field, figure, identity, or role semantics.
sourceNotes: The census permits one or more graph decompositions.

artifactTypes.description: One unlabeled graph partition inferred from attractive and repulsive edges under mutex constraints.
artifactTypes.label: Mutex-watershed partition
provenanceNotes: Segment IDs have no field, figure, identity, or UI-role meaning.
sourceNotes: Section 10 specifies one partition without seeds or a partition threshold.

artifactTypes.description: One deterministic fine-grid OKLab family label per native pixel.
artifactTypes.label: Native color-family label plane
provenanceNotes: Retains native lattice, grid policy, family identity, and exact source-pixel correspondence.
sourceNotes: Primary spatial output of evidence.family-quantization and input to four-connected family components.

artifactTypes.description: An unlabeled two-way partition of the model token grid produced by normalized cut.
artifactTypes.label: TokenCut token bipartition
provenanceNotes: Sides are structural until the TokenCut object-orientation rule is recorded; they confer no UI role or identity.
sourceNotes: Bipartition is kept separate from its image-space mask projection.

artifactTypes.description: One SLIC-style region label per pixel on the declared working raster lattice.
artifactTypes.label: Working-raster SLIC label plane
provenanceNotes: Retains working dimensions, source and resize identity, region policy, and exact label ordering.
sourceNotes: This label plane is working-raster evidence and is unsuitable as an assumed connectivity-clean segmentation API in historical 0.19.

artifactTypes.description: The differentiable approximate binary text-region map derived from probability and adaptive-threshold maps.
artifactTypes.label: DBNet approximate binary map
provenanceNotes: Range, steepness, threshold settings, model geometry, and projection must be retained; it is text evidence, not a foreground/role mask.
sourceNotes: Approximate binary map is separate from hard polygon extraction.

artifactTypes.description: Unlabeled binary supports for spatially contiguous outliers in each registered frame.
artifactTypes.label: DECOLOR contiguous outlier masks
provenanceNotes: Outlier membership has no field, figure, foreground, identity, or UI-role semantics; frame pairing and binary convention must be retained.
sourceNotes: Contiguous outlier masks are explicit DECOLOR outputs.

artifactTypes.description: Several soft or hard decomposition masks paired with reconstructed layers, carrying no semantic polarity or role meaning.
artifactTypes.label: Double-DIP unlabeled layer masks
provenanceNotes: Mask range, normalization, layer pairing, overlap policy, and checkpoint must be retained; no field/figure interpretation is attached.
sourceNotes: Masks are explicit Double-DIP outputs but are not unsupervised semantic labels.

artifactTypes.description: A native-lattice eligibility mask supplied to octave-ladder area-integral extent measurement.
artifactTypes.label: Extent-eligible native pixels
provenanceNotes: Must retain native raster identity, eligibility rule, mask hash, population, and any candidate or field attribution.
sourceNotes: Arm C's claimed input includes eligibility, but no portable Section 3 producer or contract is provided.

artifactTypes.description: A minimal development-only projection of a reviewed adequate field mask for the declared path-fitting question, retaining semantic mask value, uncertainty, coordinates, source witnesses, schema revision, and content hash but excluding review metadata and labels.
artifactTypes.label: Known-good gradient field-mask projection
provenanceNotes: Human-authored or reviewed masks are development-only inputs and cannot establish natural handoff, generalization, runtime admissibility, or complete-treatment quality.
sourceNotes: Known-good projection firewall and minimal content are specified in research/v4/STRATEGY.md:280-333.

artifactTypes.description: A naturally produced native-resolution field-membership mask with uncertainty or abstention, coordinate contract, source-raster identity, and no reviewed answer labels.
artifactTypes.label: Natural gradient field mask
provenanceNotes: Natural masks must not carry reviewer acceptance, target structure, or downstream palette answers.
sourceNotes: Natural field mask is one alternative input in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1286-1290.

artifactTypes.description: A frozen native-lattice binary mask for one declared candidate rather than a family union.
artifactTypes.label: Native binary candidate support mask
provenanceNotes: Requires frozen candidate identity, native witness, native dimensions, exact population, and mask hash.
sourceNotes: Native mask scale-space accepts candidate masks as distinct from family masks; candidate availability formation is outside this Section 3 mapping.

artifactTypes.description: A native binary mask identifying every exact occurrence of one declared source RGB color.
artifactTypes.label: Native exact-color support mask
provenanceNotes: Binds exact RGB, native raster identity, dimensions, population, and mask hash.
sourceNotes: One alternative support input; Section 3 does not define exact-color mask formation.

artifactTypes.description: A native-lattice binary mask for exactly one declared color family.
artifactTypes.label: Native binary family support mask
provenanceNotes: Binds family identity, native dimensions, membership policy, exact population, and mask hash.
sourceNotes: May be materialized from the family label plane for support and scale-space measurements.

artifactTypes.description: Prompt-associated candidate masks emitted by the pinned SAM stack without semantic purity or role authority.
artifactTypes.label: SAM candidate masks
provenanceNotes: A mask containing its prompt point or text does not establish semantic purity, field ownership, role, or truth.
sourceNotes: Section 9 limits SAM masks to visualizing subject, text, and mark hypotheses.

artifactTypes.description: The complement support left after the configured union of selected SAM masks is subtracted.
artifactTypes.label: SAM field-enriched residual mask
provenanceNotes: Residual support can retain secondary objects, text, and ornaments and has no field or role authority.
sourceNotes: The mask records the tested subtraction result rather than declaring pure field.

artifactTypes.description: The candidate wash selected or unioned by exactly one tested point-to-SAM route policy.
artifactTypes.label: SAM point-route selected wash
provenanceNotes: The tested growth routes were falsified; this mask is not ground truth, field ownership, or a runtime field mask.
sourceNotes: The wash is retained separately from both generic SAM candidates and residual subtraction masks.

artifactTypes.description: A soft mask supplied to fixed or learned differentiable soft morphology without assuming semantic polarity.
artifactTypes.label: Soft mask for soft morphology
provenanceNotes: Range, geometry, polarity if any, validity, and source must be retained; no field/figure or role semantics are implied.
sourceNotes: Soft mask is the alternative to a general scalar image.

artifactTypes.description: An image-space competing salient-object mask projected from a TokenCut bipartition.
artifactTypes.label: TokenCut salient-object mask
provenanceNotes: Projection, interpolation, polarity, threshold, and token-grid transform must be explicit; no field or identity authority is attached.
sourceNotes: The mask represents TokenCut's salient-object prior, not a UI role assignment.

artifactTypes.description: A learned producer's soft mask prediction supplied for research-only topological comparison.
artifactTypes.label: Soft predicted mask for topology loss
provenanceNotes: Producer/model revision, range, class channel, geometry, and preprocessing must be retained; the mask does not gain role authority.
sourceNotes: Soft predicted mask is a required topology-loss input.

artifactTypes.description: The coefficients reconstructing observations from the selected observed exemplars under the cited normed setting.
artifactTypes.label: Archetypoids mixture coefficients
provenanceNotes: Matrix orientation, constraints, observation order, exemplar order, and precision must be retained.
sourceNotes: Mixture coefficients are distinct from selected exemplars.

artifactTypes.description: Source-bound chromatic mass by hue direction, total mass, pixel counts, and achievable coverage ceiling for a declared number of treatment slots.
artifactTypes.label: Artwork chromatic gamut
provenanceNotes: The measurement binds the source raster and gamut policy.
sourceNotes: research/v2-3/src/internal/gamut-coverage.ts:166-181 defines ArtworkGamut.

artifactTypes.description: Border coverage, per-side coverage, corner count, interior ownership, and border-versus-interior excess for one support source.
artifactTypes.label: Border and frame ownership diagnostics
provenanceNotes: Retains support identity, coordinate policy, denominators, threshold if any, and explicit undefined states.
sourceNotes: These values are evidence and never field authority by themselves.

artifactTypes.description: Declared pairwise color-distance values keyed to edges of the region adjacency graph.
artifactTypes.label: Boundary-connectivity region color distances
provenanceNotes: Region color statistic, color space, distance formula, edge mapping, scale, and precision must be retained.
sourceNotes: Color distances are a separate explicit saliency-graph input.

artifactTypes.description: Per-region measurements of contact extent with the declared image boundary.
artifactTypes.label: Region boundary contacts
provenanceNotes: Boundary definition, contact metric, frame handling, region IDs, normalization, and image geometry must be retained.
sourceNotes: Boundary contacts are a distinct required input to the background prior.

artifactTypes.description: Per-region measurements of area-normalized connection strength to the image boundary.
artifactTypes.label: Region boundary-connectivity scores
provenanceNotes: Scores encode a geometric prior only and do not establish background, field ownership, or UI role.
sourceNotes: Boundary-connectivity values are kept distinct from derived background probabilities.

artifactTypes.description: Signed or absolute contrast measurements for one candidate against a flat field or sampled rendered field.
artifactTypes.label: Candidate-to-field contrast evidence
provenanceNotes: Candidate, field, metric, polarity, sample positions, and minimum location remain attached.
sourceNotes: Contrast can establish a legibility floor but cannot establish foreground identity.

artifactTypes.description: Reconstruction state and, when available, the canonical named 27-component vector, five block decisions, evidence identities, and exact values. Unreconstructable is an explicit state with reasons.
artifactTypes.label: Canonical component-vector reconstruction
provenanceNotes: Unavailable components are not represented as zero or passing values.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1524-1531 and NATIVE_COMPLETE_PALETTE_PROTOCOL.md:310-323 require a reconstructable canonical vector and preserve canonical otherwise.

artifactTypes.description: One color family with prototype, exact representatives, components, population, chroma, salience, connectivity, field ownership, and polarity observations where measured.
artifactTypes.label: Source-connected color-family evidence
provenanceNotes: Every exact representative retains its source witness; synthesized representatives are identified separately.
sourceNotes: Section 4 consumes family evidence without treating a family as an elected UI role.

artifactTypes.description: Reportable exact-triple population, family population, connected mass, and denominator measurements for one source color.
artifactTypes.label: Color population and exact mass
provenanceNotes: Color witness, source raster, counting rule, and denominator remain explicit.
sourceNotes: Population remains reportable evidence even though no tested threshold established role eligibility.

artifactTypes.description: Per-component edge, contrast, variance, geometry, repetition, polarity, compactness, and stroke-width measurements.
artifactTypes.label: Component-local raster measurements
provenanceNotes: Retains component identity, raster identity, local neighborhood, formulas, scale normalization, and unavailable cues.
sourceNotes: Structural text-shape interpretation requires these measurements, but Section 3 contains no single mechanism that provides the complete vector.

artifactTypes.description: Uncertain per-component evidence for title-like typography or signature marks, without assigning a text label or UI role.
artifactTypes.label: Component typography and signature evidence
provenanceNotes: Retains source component, cue values, cue availability, uncertainty, and method identity.
sourceNotes: Output of the bounded structural text-shape mechanism; remains distinct from root foreground colors and pixel-retention diagnostics.

artifactTypes.description: An ordered, possibly empty history of prior fixation coordinates and timing under a declared coordinate system.
artifactTypes.label: DeepGaze III previous-fixation history
provenanceNotes: Observer/session identity, coordinate transform, timing, censoring, and history order must be retained when present.
sourceNotes: Previous fixations condition the next-fixation density; an empty history represents the first fixation.

artifactTypes.description: The complete per-image DINO forward-pass activations containing the CLS token and every patch token before pooling.
artifactTypes.label: DINO CLS and all patch tokens
provenanceNotes: This prohibited-runtime activation artifact must remain paired with its raster, model, and preprocessing identities.
sourceNotes: Section 9 says existing stored vectors are insufficient because these patch tokens were discarded.

artifactTypes.description: One separately tagged 2048-dimensional pooled vector per image from CLS concatenated with the mean of all patch tokens.
artifactTypes.label: DINO CLS plus mean-patch embedding
provenanceNotes: The vector is not an adopted arm, duplicate component, semantic truth, or runtime feature.
sourceNotes: This proposed vector remains distinct from the existing global-embedding contract and has no local measurement yet.

artifactTypes.description: Declared local dissimilarity values keyed to stable edges of a pixel or region adjacency graph.
artifactTypes.label: Adjacency-edge dissimilarities
provenanceNotes: Metric, scale, quantization, and tie behavior remain part of the value contract.
sourceNotes: Section 10 names dissimilarity separately from adjacency and connectivity constraints.

artifactTypes.description: One low or high occupied local band with its pixels, support distribution, spread, geometry, and fit lineage.
artifactTypes.label: Occupied field endpoint band
provenanceNotes: Band identity and low/high orientation remain attached to all derived representatives.
sourceNotes: Endpoint-band evidence is local to an accepted fit and is not interchangeable with a global family.

artifactTypes.description: A source-supported signed foreground lightness-polarity observation with confidence and family or mark lineage.
artifactTypes.label: Foreground polarity observation
provenanceNotes: Unpolarized or weak observations remain represented rather than coerced to a direction.
sourceNotes: Polarity is evaluated relative to the considered field where required.

artifactTypes.description: A coupling over stable support IDs from two weighted attributed metric spaces under one pinned fused objective and solver execution.
artifactTypes.label: Fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling
provenanceNotes: Includes initialization, restart, convergence, objective, and support-order identity; a nonconverged run has no valid coupling.
sourceNotes: Coupling output at MECHANISMS.md:2217-2218.

artifactTypes.description: One arm-tagged L2-normalized global descriptor vector per offline corpus file.
artifactTypes.label: L2-normalized global image embeddings
provenanceNotes: Vectors mix subject, layout, and palette and are neither truth nor runtime palette features.
sourceNotes: Section 9 supports these descriptors only for bounded offline diagnostics.

artifactTypes.description: A fitted continuous color target for one ordered endpoint, retaining fit identity, endpoint side, domain, coordinate contract, and uncertainty without claiming source-pixel publishability.
artifactTypes.label: Continuous gradient endpoint target
provenanceNotes: A target is not a publishable color and must not be substituted for an exact native witness.
sourceNotes: Continuous target followed by exact-pixel redemption is specified in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1128-1133.

artifactTypes.description: The declared color-space distance from a continuous endpoint target to the selected exact native source witness, with both identities and units.
artifactTypes.label: Endpoint target-to-witness distance
provenanceNotes: Distance must retain color-space and target identities so narrowing and snap cliffs remain auditable.
sourceNotes: Target-to-witness distance is an explicit endpoint-snap output in research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1130-1131.

artifactTypes.description: A directed principal axis in OKLab color covariance computed only from pixels owned by the field domain, with sign/orientation and domain identity.
artifactTypes.label: Field color-covariance principal axis
provenanceNotes: A whole-image or spatial principal axis is not compatible with this artifact type.
sourceNotes: The axis is color-covariance, not spatial, and field-domain-local in research/ALBUM_ARTWORK_UI_PALETTE_FIELD_GUIDE.md:351-355.

artifactTypes.description: Per-sample distance from the rendered OKLab stop path to the nearest sufficiently populated artwork color, including worst excursion, worst position, path identity, and support-set identity.
artifactTypes.label: Gradient ramp excursion measurement
provenanceNotes: This is a reusable measurement consumed by excursion midpoint insertion; it is not terminal and is not itself a human quality score.
sourceNotes: Measurement implementation is research/v2-3/src/internal/ramp-midpoint.ts:174-221.

artifactTypes.description: One declared dissimilarity value per edge of a compatible pixel or region graph.
artifactTypes.label: Graph edge dissimilarities
provenanceNotes: Must bind graph identity, edge order, color or region attributes, formula, units, ties, and nonfinite handling.
sourceNotes: FH merging requires edge dissimilarities, but Section 3 does not define their computation for either graph alternative.

artifactTypes.description: The fitted locally adaptive piecewise-polynomial scalar signal over graph vertices.
artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtered signal
provenanceNotes: The fitted signal is synthetic scalar evidence and has no field/figure or role semantics.
sourceNotes: Fitted signal is a distinct graph trend-filtering output.

artifactTypes.description: The scalar residual between the input graph signal and its fitted signal.
artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtering residual
provenanceNotes: Sign, units, support, and source/fitted revisions must be retained.
sourceNotes: Residual is distinct from fitted signal and knot support.

artifactTypes.description: A scalar signal keyed to stable vertices of an image-derived graph.
artifactTypes.label: Graph trend-filtering signal
provenanceNotes: Signal units, validity, vertex mapping, and any channel identity must be retained; independent channels are not a joint vector formulation.
sourceNotes: The cited graph trend-filtering formulation is scalar.

artifactTypes.description: Non-public observation-to-cluster memberships together with packed-RGB weighted mean centers.
artifactTypes.label: Internal legacy k-means cluster state
provenanceNotes: Preserves input observation order, membership indices, mean centers, empty-cluster invalidity, and convergence state; it is not the public cluster map.
sourceNotes: Mechanically formed inside legacy k-means but explicitly not returned in its public result; the separate publication mechanism therefore retains this as an unresolved required handoff.

artifactTypes.description: Contrast, homogeneity, entropy, and pattern histograms for declared local neighborhoods or regions.
artifactTypes.label: Local or region-level texture descriptors
provenanceNotes: Retains source plane, spatial support, descriptor policy, every histogram or scalar, scale, orientation, and aggregation scope.
sourceNotes: Descriptor similarity does not determine whether typography, halftone, grain, or other material belongs to a field.

artifactTypes.description: Salience, spatial coherence, exact-source support, and retained mass diagnostics for one candidate mark group.
artifactTypes.label: Mark salience and coherence evidence
provenanceNotes: Mass remains a separate diagnostic and is never discarded by salience normalization.
sourceNotes: Coherent salience is considered before mass ordering without making rarity an eligibility rule.

artifactTypes.description: One mark's support mass and unnormalized internal cue totals with region, family, and image-area measurements.
artifactTypes.label: Mark support and cue totals
provenanceNotes: Original mark mass remains reportable after normalization.
sourceNotes: The denominator distinguishes mark mass from total image area.

artifactTypes.description: Source-bound occupancy witnesses for colors in the native raster.
artifactTypes.label: Native color occupancy
provenanceNotes: Measurements retain native-raster and color-space identity.
sourceNotes: MECHANISMS.md 7.1 requires native occupancy for source-color checks.

artifactTypes.description: Lower and upper bounds in the exact preprocessed neural input coordinate system, with perturbation norm/radius derivation, clipping, and source-input identity.
artifactTypes.label: Neural input intervals
provenanceNotes: Bounds must match model preprocessing and do not imply native-pixel admissibility.
sourceNotes: Input-bounds input at MECHANISMS.md:2353-2356.

artifactTypes.description: Sound lower and upper bounds for each declared neural output under one model and input-interval contract, including propagation precision and unsupported-operation status.
artifactTypes.label: Neural output intervals
provenanceNotes: Loose intervals remain valid but may be vacuous; invalid propagation is not represented as sound intervals.
sourceNotes: Output-interval result at MECHANISMS.md:2355-2356.

artifactTypes.description: The declared dark-or-light and neutral-or-saturated region classification used to select an identity tolerance.
artifactTypes.label: OKLab identity region classification
provenanceNotes: Hard region boundaries and the classification rule are consequential provenance.
sourceNotes: Represents the region-classification input at research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:159-160.

artifactTypes.description: Criterion-by-alternative performances with stable IDs, maximize/minimize orientation, units, missingness, and numeric precision, but no hidden weights or thresholds.
artifactTypes.label: Oriented criterion performance table
provenanceNotes: Binds every row and column to stable criterion and alternative definitions.
sourceNotes: Oriented criterion performances at MECHANISMS.md:2289-2290.

artifactTypes.description: A flattened ordered sequence of distinct packed RGB values and nonnegative population counts.
artifactTypes.label: Packed RGB color-count observations
provenanceNotes: Observation order is consequential to initialization and ties; counts preserve full weighted population.
sourceNotes: Legacy k-means, elbow, and gap implementations consume repeated color,count pairs; histogram formation is not a Section 3 mechanism.

artifactTypes.description: Mass and geometry measurements including exact population, local same-color mass, connected share, family concentration, spread, and observation breadth.
artifactTypes.label: Population, connectivity, and spread vector
provenanceNotes: Every value retains its exact denominator, source mask, native raster, neighborhood definition, and null behavior.
sourceNotes: Report-only support evidence under v3; it is not a belonging or validity gate.

artifactTypes.description: Evidence computed without reading portfolio member identity, including declared description-length and coverage terms for comparing rival complete extractors.
artifactTypes.label: Portfolio member-independent evidence
provenanceNotes: Evidence records its member-independence assumptions and source scope.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1436-1439 requires member-independent evidence.

artifactTypes.description: Per-pixel normalized X and Y coordinates paired exactly with a source raster geometry.
artifactTypes.label: RGBXY normalized pixel coordinates
provenanceNotes: Origin, axis direction, pixel-center convention, normalization range, dimensions, and source-raster digest must be retained.
sourceNotes: Normalized pixel coordinates are a distinct RGBXY decomposition input.

artifactTypes.description: All pair, stop, contrast, collapse, source, and field legality checks for an unchanged or foreground-accent-swapped candidate treatment.
artifactTypes.label: Foreground-accent swap legality assessment
provenanceNotes: Assessment identifies the treatment, role claims, field, and validation policy.
sourceNotes: Both resulting role pairs and every rendered stop require revalidation.

artifactTypes.description: Model scores associated one-for-one with SAM candidate masks under the pinned stack and cut policy.
artifactTypes.intentionalTerminalPurpose: Inspect model scoring behavior alongside candidate masks.
artifactTypes.label: SAM candidate mask scores
provenanceNotes: Model confidence is not semantic purity and cannot authorize a mask.
sourceNotes: Section 9 requires scores among SAM outputs.

artifactTypes.description: One scalar per treatment and its constituent weighted contributions under a named exchange-rate configuration, including an explicit empty evaluation set.
artifactTypes.label: Scalar treatment quality evaluations
provenanceNotes: The scalar remains tied to its axes and exchange rates.
sourceNotes: research/v4/MECHANISMS.md:1405-1408 defines the weighted scalar output.

artifactTypes.description: Revisioned segment, salience, reconstruction, diversity, and coverage feature values for one image/theme pair, with segment and feature implementation identity.
artifactTypes.label: Segmented image-theme features
provenanceNotes: Feature implementation and segmentation revision must match the fitted model contract.
sourceNotes: Segmented image features at MECHANISMS.md:2306-2309.

artifactTypes.description: Component signatures and counts, largest mass, boundary density, side ownership, thickness, enclosure, reach, and explicit undefined values.
artifactTypes.label: Support topology descriptor vector
provenanceNotes: Retains input support identity, threshold, topology policy, exact normalization, component ordering, and undefined states.
sourceNotes: Diagnostic geometry only; no field, frame, typography, or figure authority is conferred.

artifactTypes.description: Per-image pretrained-transformer patch tokens with explicit token-grid geometry.
artifactTypes.label: TokenCut transformer patch-token grid
